entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: A school of magic on the island of Lat-Nam founded by Drafna and Hurkyl, destroyed during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Island on Dominaria where the college stood.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Co-founder of the college, who later founded the City of Shadows.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Co-founder of the college and Drafna's wife.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City where Drafna and Hurkyl met the Archimandrite and formed the Third Path.

entities.name: Union of the Third Path
entities.description: Neutral group formed to side with neither Urza nor Mishra.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group that helped create the Third Path.

entities.name: Archimandrite of the Ivory Tower
entities.description: Met Drafna and Hurkyl in Terisia City.

entities.name: Sages of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The conclave of wizards at the college, the largest ever convened.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: Powerful artifact launched into space that fell at White Ridge four thousand years later.

entities.name: Duler angels
entities.description: Angels the sages created from humans to protect the island.

entities.name: Fall of the College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Destruction of the college by the brothers.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: City on Iwset founded by surviving Third Path members.

events.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl found the college to codify magic, understand Thran artifacts and stop the brothers.
events.quote: The College of Lat-Nam was founded by Drafna and Hurkyl

events.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl go to Terisia City and create the Union of the Third Path with the Archimandrite and the Brotherhood of Gix.
events.quote: they created the Union of the Third Path

events.summary: The sages create the Stone Brain, which is launched into space instead of being destroyed.
The brothers destroy the college and many of its sages.
events.quote: the school itself was destroyed by the Brothers at some point during the war

events.summary: Surviving Third Path members including Drafna found the City of Shadows on Iwset.
events.quote: later founded the City of Shadows on the nearby island of Iwset

relations.note: The married couple who founded the college.
relations.quote: the married couple Drafna and Hurkyl
